raw_segments.text: You might have guessed from the fact of my asking you not to go to Moscow, but to teacher
Mashnya that I wanted to have you nearer, for Moscow's a long way off, and Dmitry
Fyodorovich, knowing you are not far off, would not be so bold.
And if anything had happened, you might have come to protect me, too, for I warned you
of Grigory Vasilyevich's illness, and that I was afraid of having a fit.
And when I explained those knocks to you, by means of which one could go into the deceased,
and that Dmitry Fyodorovich knew them all through me, I thought that you would guess
yourself that he would be sure to do something, and so wouldn't go to teacher Mashnya even,
